checkpoints: 检查测试是否包含对未处理字段（pass-through）的断言
确认测试命名是否描述了被测行为

pattern.code:
import pytest
from vllm_ascend.models.kimi_k3 import AscendKimiK3ForCausalLM


class TestKimiK3VisionConfig:
    """测试 Kimi K3 视觉配置相关逻辑"""

    def test_kimi_k3_model_declares_checkpoint_packing_contract(self):
        """测试 packed_modules_mapping 契约：确保 MoE experts 的 packed modules
        按照 w1(gate), w3(up), w2(down) 的顺序声明"""
        assert AscendKimiK3ForCausalLM.packed_modules_mapping["experts"] == [
            "experts.0.w1", "experts.0.w3", "experts.0.w2",
        ]

    def test_kimi_k3_drops_legacy_vision_chunk_flag(self):
        """测试规范化逻辑移除了 legacy use_unified_vision_chunk flag"""
        config = self._make_config()
        normalized = normalize_vision_config(config)
        # 聚焦实际行为：legacy flag 被移除
        assert not hasattr(normalized, "use_unified_vision_chunk")

    def test_kimi_k3_maps_vt_fields_to_canonical_vision_fields(self):
        """测试 checkpoint 中的 vt_* 字段被正确映射到 vLLM 标准视觉字段"""
        config = self._make_config()
        normalized = normalize_vision_config(config)
        # 聚焦实际行为：vt_* 字段映射
        assert normalized.vision_field_mapping == {...}

    def test_kimi_k3_aligns_projector_width_with_text_hidden_size(self):
        """测试 projector width 与 text hidden size 对齐"""
        config = self._make_config()
        normalized = normalize_vision_config(config)
        # 聚焦实际行为：projector width 对齐
        assert normalized.projector_width == config.text_hidden_size
